purpose: Apply explicit add, update, delete, and rename operations to an existing text project in staged state, validate the repaired body, and publish it transactionally only when checks pass.

properties.operations: non-empty list of explicit add/update/delete/rename operations
properties.expected_files: optional exact text expectations for final files

relationships: repairs an existing creation body without regenerating untouched files
stages the change before the original project is replaced
keeps the original body as rollback material until post-publish validation passes

anatomy_refs.basis: The capability provides an explicit bounded text-project patch assembly with deterministic add/update/delete/rename operations, transactional publication, and validation; it does not claim semantic source-code transformation beyond those operations.
The patch is applied to an existing project body and preserves untouched project files.

limitations: current repair operations replace whole UTF-8 file contents rather than performing semantic AST edits
grammar identification does not imply parser validation for grammars without an explicit current validator
generated code is not executed by this capability

truth.basis: The result separates supplied repair intent from observed applied operations and deterministic validation, and does not promote grammar identification into semantic correctness.

agency.basis: The caller supplies the target, exact operations, and checks; the capability does not invent unrelated edits.

continuity.basis: Repair starts from the existing project, preserves untouched files, and retains the original body until the repaired body passes post-publish validation.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The smallest explicit file operations can repair an existing creation instead of regenerating the complete project.
